title: M2C
body:
# A Performance-Focused Client Modpack

M2C is a modpack that designed to improve Minecraft’s performance without requiring any external engines or manual setup.

Everything works out-of-the-box: just install the pack and launch the game.

## This project is intended for players who want:

- Higher FPS with Sodium, Iris, and other optimization mods

- A smoother experience with UI, culling, and rendering improvements

- A lightweight and clean client setup

- Zero extra configuration or advanced system requirements

For more visual enhancement, you may refer to the [M3C](https://modrinth.com/modpack/m3c).
You can find the mods used [here](https://modrinth.com/modpack/m2c/version/1.0.0).
